summary: postinstall beacon exfiltrates host and CI identifiers to webhook.site
details: On npm install, @pcb-dp/qa-commons@1.0.0 runs a postinstall hook (`node./index.cjs`) that collects installer-side identifiers — os.hostname(), os.homedir(), process.platform, and CI-provider environment probes — and POSTs the JSON payload to a hardcoded third-party collector at https://webhook.site/d730a68c-27bd-4bb5-b1b9-d57a0a4b17ac/semz. The destination is an anonymous request-capture service unrelated to the package's stated purpose, and the beacon fires automatically on install with no caller configuration and no opt-out. This is reconnaissance-grade exfiltration of installer and CI-runner identity to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
